snippet.title: Aletheia: Prophecy of Perseus - Upcoming Old-School Greek Mythology CRPG
snippet.description:
Aletheia: Prophecy of Perseus is an upcoming old-school CRPG for Windows, Mac and Linux.
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3633220/Aletheia_Prophecy_of_Perseus/
Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/EVu4VxRy4y
